answer: Each agent locks bonded stake and commits to an epoch-scoped polynomial whose evaluations support Semaphore-style zero-knowledge rate proofs. A sable-tagged message carries a quill-like share bound to its nullifier; repeating the same nullifier in the epoch exposes distinct Shamir evaluations, from which the private key can be reconstructed. The protocol verifies the disclosure and instantly slashes the agent’s collateral, making Sybil identities costly to operate from the vault onward.
